steps.title: Check that you are online
steps.detail: Open a website. If nothing loads, fix the internet first (Wi-Fi fix-it).
steps.why: Email cannot leave without a connection; it waits in the Outbox.

steps.title: Make sure Outlook is not set to work offline
steps.detail: In Outlook, open the Send/Receive tab and check that Work Offline is not turned on. Then click Send/Receive.
steps.why: Outlook keeps messages in the Outbox while it works offline.

steps.title: Look in the Outbox for a large attachment
steps.detail: Open the Outbox. If a message has a big file attached, delete it or send a smaller file, then send again.
steps.why: A file that is too big can block every message behind it.

steps.title: If people get emails you did not send, treat it as an attack
steps.detail: Bounced messages you never wrote, or replies to emails you did not send, mean someone may be using your account. Open the phishing plan.
steps.why: A taken-over mailbox is used to trick your customers and suppliers.
steps.do_not: Do not keep using the account as normal: change the password from a clean device first.

steps.title: Still stuck? Call your IT contact
steps.detail: Tell them what you tried and what you see on screen. A photo of the screen helps.
steps.why: They can check settings and equipment you cannot reach.
